data.summary: Beispielhof Serviced Living GmbH informs Harriet Collins that her fixed-term lease for apartment B 3.07 ends on 31 January 2027, and offers a six- or twelve-month extension at the current rent if she replies in writing by 16 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your furnished-apartment lease is set to end on 31 January 2027. The landlord offers you the choice to extend it for six or twelve months at the same rent, but you must tell them in writing by the deadline shown. If you don't respond, they will assume you are moving out and prepare the apartment handover for the end of January. Decide whether you want to stay longer and send your answer (e.g. by email) well before the deadline to avoid losing your apartment.
